author: GameSpot
description:
Yasmine is a mixup monster.

Yasmine excels in the mid and close range, rushing down her opponents with multi hitting attacks and tricky air mobility. And once Yasmine has the advantage, she can further lockdown her foe with an offensive boomerang special, providing an opportunity for a mixup. Here's gameplay of this mixup monster with the CPU set to level 7 mirror matches.
